scope: A root-only diagnostic driver joined the installed identity-service cgroup, created a synthetic owner project/chat in the live database, and used byte-verified v7 Jobs/worker source plus the installed watchdog socket. Only a private copy of the fixed JSON fixture was changed to add a 20-second guest delay. The immutable production v7 release and its executable JSON fixture were not changed. The driver supplied owner scope directly; OIDC, browser authorization, and the production JSON program were not exercised by this fault test.

diagnostic_attempts.cause: The main diagnostic process used the installed Python environment, which lacks os.pidfd_open. The host system Python provides pidfd_open and pidfd_send_signal.
The first delayed-fixture Jobs run reached the worker's 10-second execution limit before the original observer captured a RUNNING resource; the observer had no per-state instrumentation.
The observer checked only the driver's main thread for children. Jobs launched its worker from a background thread.

diagnostic_attempts.observer_change: Enumerate children of every driver and worker thread; require exact worker argv, resource/token, parent-child relationship, and service cgroup before opening pidfds or applying the fault.

limits: The test used a trusted root driver and direct synthetic owner scope, bypassing OIDC/browser entry. It does not establish collaborator authorization or broad end-to-end acceptance.
Only the test copy of the JSON fixture was delayed. The production fixed JSON program was not changed, and this fault result does not claim production-action timing.
The installed socket message sequence was not independently packet-traced. The observed Jobs/worker/watchdog behavior exercised the pinned code path and installed socket.
Shields Up was set before fault injection as a maintenance guard. This test does not prove the watchdog itself raised Shields Up from false.
The 30-second resource-absence poll is one bounded observation, not a hard SLA under all runtime stalls, host disconnects, or arbitrary workloads.

The root-only resolver handled one real synthetic uncertain row after inspection; it did not recover a trusted execution result. Three test-only chats/runs and audit events remain in the live database. Grants and model dispatches did not change.
No provider-call cancellation, broad security assurance, owner acceptance, or private-pilot readiness is established.
privacy: Contains no host name, cloud project, account, credential, private path, transcript, run ID, request key, or private URL.
